reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual third-round review of external-03 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 11 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

entries.positive_observation: External-03 removes the large top clipboard clip and retains only the source's small dark right-edge tab. The note has two upper gray-mark rows, no third row and largely blank lower paper. The restored image-left three-quarter pose and down-left gaze remain. Dark brushed-back hair, dark eyebrows and thin rectangular spectacles remain. The separate dark-grey upper-lip moustache and connected short grey beard cover the chin and both lower-jaw curves, while the upper central cheeks around the spectacles remain yellow; the beard was not reduced to a central goatee or expanded over the spectacle cheeks. One sober closed mouth and the plain dark navy-black close-collared garment remain, with a short broad collar transition. The complete dark tilted frame and opaque dark blue-grey photographic backing remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine spectacle rims, individual beard hairs, obscured garment details and exact note glyph shapes are not reliably readable at source scale. These uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the corrected pose/beard, absent large clip, small right-edge tab and two-row note structure are directly visible.
